comment: Turns the Flat Rate shipping method on or off at checkout.
modal: When set to **Yes**, the Flat Rate carrier is offered at checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: The Flat Rate method name shown to customers at checkout.
modal: The label shown next to the Flat Rate price in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: The flat shipping amount charged by the Flat Rate method.
modal: The fixed shipping charge applied by the Flat Rate carrier. Can be set per website.

comment: How the Flat Rate handling fee is calculated.
modal: Sets the basis for the handling fee added to Flat Rate shipping — for example a fixed amount or a proportion of the rate. Works together with **Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

comment: The handling fee added to the Flat Rate shipping charge.
modal: The handling fee amount added to Flat Rate shipping, applied according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

comment: The position of Flat Rate among the shipping methods at checkout.
modal: A sort-order number controlling where Flat Rate appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

comment: The heading shown for the Flat Rate carrier at checkout.
modal: The carrier title displayed above the Flat Rate method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: The basis on which the flat rate is charged.
modal: Determines what the flat rate applies to — for example once per order or per item in the order. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Flat Rate is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether Flat Rate is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

comment: The countries Flat Rate is offered to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The set of destination countries for which Flat Rate is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Flat Rate still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
modal: When **Yes**, the Flat Rate method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown when Flat Rate shipping is unavailable for the order.
modal: The error text displayed to customers when Flat Rate cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.

comment: How the Table Rates handling fee is calculated.
modal: Sets the basis for the handling fee added to Table Rate shipping — for example a fixed amount or a proportion of the rate. Works together with **Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

comment: The handling fee added to the Table Rates shipping charge.
modal: The handling fee amount added to Table Rate shipping, applied according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

comment: Turns the Table Rates shipping method on or off at checkout.
modal: When set to **Yes**, the Table Rates carrier is offered at checkout, using the imported rate table. Can be set per website.

comment: The order condition the rate table is looked up by.
modal: Selects which order measure the Table Rates lookup is based on, such as weight, price, or item count. The imported rate table must match the condition chosen here. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether virtual products count toward the value used to look up table rates.
modal: When **Yes**, virtual products are included in the order value used for the Table Rates lookup. Can be set per website.

comment: Downloads the current table rate data as a CSV file.
modal: Exports this website's Table Rates to a CSV file for editing or backup. Operates at website scope.

comment: Uploads a CSV file of table rates for this website.
modal: Imports a CSV file defining the Table Rates for this website, replacing the existing rate table. Operates at website scope.

comment: The Table Rates method name shown to customers at checkout.
modal: The label shown next to the Table Rates price in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: The position of Table Rates among the shipping methods at checkout.
modal: A sort-order number controlling where Table Rates appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

comment: The heading shown for the Table Rates carrier at checkout.
modal: The carrier title displayed above the Table Rates method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether Table Rates is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether Table Rates is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

comment: The countries Table Rates is offered to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The set of destination countries for which Table Rates is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Table Rates still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
modal: When **Yes**, the Table Rates method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown when Table Rates shipping is unavailable for the order.
modal: The error text displayed to customers when Table Rates cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.

comment: Turns the Free Shipping method on or off at checkout.
modal: When set to **Yes**, the Free Shipping carrier is offered at checkout for qualifying orders. Can be set per website.

comment: The order subtotal a customer must reach to qualify for free shipping.
modal: The minimum order amount that makes an order eligible for Free Shipping. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the minimum order amount is compared against the subtotal including tax.
modal: When **Yes**, the **Minimum Order Amount** is checked against the subtotal with tax included rather than excluded. Can be set per website.

comment: The Free Shipping method name shown to customers at checkout.
modal: The label shown next to the Free Shipping option in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: The position of Free Shipping among the shipping methods at checkout.
modal: A sort-order number controlling where Free Shipping appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

comment: The heading shown for the Free Shipping carrier at checkout.
modal: The carrier title displayed above the Free Shipping method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether Free Shipping is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether Free Shipping is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

comment: The countries Free Shipping is offered to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The set of destination countries for which Free Shipping is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether Free Shipping still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
modal: When **Yes**, the Free Shipping method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown when Free Shipping is unavailable for the order.
modal: The error text displayed to customers when Free Shipping cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.
